title: Level-up moment
description: The file game/tuning/level_up.json: the level-up rest, the banner's timeline, look and motion, and the HUD level pop, read in both run modes. DRA-148. The file must exist; every field of every section is required and nothing has a default in code. Ticks are counted from the tick the level rises (age 0, the state after that tick). Colors are either '#rrggbb' or a key of the HUD palette in game/tuning/hud.json. The three top-level numbers go to core.level_up.LevelUpRules; every section goes to ui.level_up_rules.LevelUpLook, the record of the same name (docs/contracts/systems/level-up/tuning.md). Loaded and checked by hand by game/app/level_up_tuning.py at startup (no schema library: pygbag has none), which also checks the rules a schema can't express (the same part). Owner of the schema: architect. Contract: docs/contracts/systems/level-up.md.

tick.description: A tick count from the rise tick, an integer, never a bool.

count.description: A length in ticks or a count, an integer >= 1, never a bool.

color.description: '#rrggbb' or a key of the HUD palette (game/tuning/hud.json, palette).

level_up_rest.description: Ticks added to the rest after the last wave of a level, on a level rise. 08-difficulty.md, level_up_rest (guess). 0 turns the rest, the banner, the pop and the cue off. Never scaled by level. Maps to LevelUpRules.rest_ticks.

arrival_tick.description: Age at which the flying number reaches the HUD and the HUD level box switches to the new level and pops. 10-ui.md, level_up_banner and hud_level_pop (guess). Must be below banner_ticks. Maps to LevelUpRules.arrival_ticks.

banner_ticks.description: States the banner lives on before core drops it (age 0 to banner_ticks - 1). At most level_up_rest when that is above 0; at least arrival_tick + pop.ticks. Maps to LevelUpRules.banner_ticks.

colors.description: Every banner and pop color. Palette keys reuse the HUD's colors (12-art-and-audio.md, HUD colors); the two new colors are hex. No fuchsia, no fuchsia key: solid fuchsia in the play area means a coin (12-art-and-audio.md, rule 6).

hairline.description: The two hairlines and their corner ticks.

number_top.description: The number's gradient at its top.

number_bottom.description: The number's gradient at its bottom.

ring.description: The ring that bursts out on landing.

glint.description: The glint that crosses the number.

flash.description: The white of the new pip's flash, the HUD number's flash and the new climb bar's flash.

band.description: The see-through glass band across the middle of the play area and its two hairlines.

height.description: Full height of the glass, px.

alpha.description: Glass opacity, 0 to 255. 0 draws no glass (the hairlines stay): the escape hatch if the band costs too much.

center_offset_y.description: Px the band's center sits below the play area's center. May be negative.

open_start.description: Age the band starts to open.

close_start.description: Age the band starts to close.

close_end.description: Age it is fully closed. At most arrival_tick.

close_glass_share.description: Share of the closing window in which the glass closes; the hairlines pull in during the rest of it.

corner_tick_length.description: Length of the small tick at each hairline end, px. 0 draws none.

number.description: The big level number: type, outline, fall, landing squash.

center_offset_y.description: Px the number's resting center sits below the band's center. May be negative.

fall_start.description: Age the number starts to fall, from fully above the play area.

fall_end.description: Age it lands (the landing tick). The squash, the bump, the ring and the streaks start here.

fall_overshoot_px.description: Px the number goes past its resting place before it settles back. 0 for none.

fall_peak_share.description: Share of the fall at which the number is deepest past its place.

squash_ticks.description: Ticks the landing squash takes to settle back to 1x.

squash_x.description: Width scale on the landing tick.

squash_y.description: Height scale on the landing tick.

pose_steps.description: Pre-rendered sizes between the squash and 1x. The view picks the nearest.

label.description: The word LEVEL above the number: Share Tech Mono, letter-spaced.

offset_y.description: Px the label's center sits from the band's center (negative is above).

fade_in_start.description: Age it starts to fade in.

fade_in_end.description: Age it is fully in, letter spacing back to normal.

spacing_wide.description: Letter spacing at the start of the fade-in, px.

spacing_steps.description: Pre-rendered spacings between wide and normal.

hold.description: When the label and the pips fade out, ahead of the flight.

fade_out_start.description: Age the label and the pips start to fade.

pips.description: The row of one pip per level under the number (the climb bars, as pips).

size.description: Width and height of a diamond, px.

pitch.description: Px from one pip's center to the next.

offset_y.description: Px the row's center sits from the band's center (positive is below).

start.description: Age the first pip starts to appear.

end.description: Age the last pip is fully in.

pop_ticks.description: Ticks one pip takes to appear. At most end - start.

flash_ticks.description: Ticks the new pip's white flash takes to fade to its lit color.

ring.description: The ring that bursts out of the number on landing.

start_diameter.description: Px across on the landing tick.

end_diameter.description: Px across as it fades out.

ticks.description: States it shows on from the landing tick.

streaks.description: The short light streaks that fly out of the number on landing, evenly spread.

ticks.description: States they show on from the landing tick.

start_radius.description: Distance of a streak's inner end from the number's center on the landing tick, px.

end_radius.description: Distance it flies out to by its last state, px.

glint.description: The one light glint that sweeps across the number.

start.description: Age the glint starts to cross.

frames.description: Pre-rendered positions of the glint across the number.

width.description: Width of the glint band, px.

slant_degrees.description: Lean of the band from vertical, degrees, 0 up to 89.

strength.description: How far the glint pulls the number's colors toward the glint color, above 0 up to 1.

bump.description: The play area's picture bumps down on landing and springs back. Drawing only.

pixels.description: Px the picture moves down at the peak. 0 turns the bump off.

ticks.description: Ticks from the landing tick until the picture is back.

peak_share.description: Share of the bump at which the picture is lowest.

fly.description: The number's flight into the HUD level box. It ends on arrival_tick.

start.description: Age the number leaves its place and starts to shrink and fly. Below arrival_tick.

arc_px.description: How far the flight's path bows up from the straight line, px. 0 flies straight.

steps.description: Pre-rendered sizes along the flight. The view picks the nearest.

pop.description: The HUD level readout's pop on arrival, in the level box.

ticks.description: Ticks from arrival until the pop is over. At least every flash length below.

start_scale.description: Size of the number on arrival as a multiple of its normal size. Above 1.

undershoot_scale.description: The smallest multiple the number settles through before it rests at 1. Above 0, at most 1.

undershoot_share.description: Share of the pop at which it is at undershoot_scale.

flash_ticks.description: Ticks the number's white flash takes to fade to its tier color.

steps.description: Pre-rendered frames of the pop per level (size and flash together).

bar_flash_ticks.description: Ticks the new climb bar's white flash takes to fade to its lit color.

box_flash_ticks.description: Ticks the box outline's flash takes to fade out.

box_flash_width.description: Thickness of the flashing outline, px.

box_corner_cut.description: Size of the level box's two cut corners, px. It must equal the cut the panel art draws (10 x panel.scale in tools/art/hud_panel.py).
